newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates close slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates close slightly lower.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates ended slightly down on Monday amid relatively loose liquidity in the banking system, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate closed at 6.558 percent against Saturday's 6.582 percent close -- still far outside the central bank's five to 5.5 percent target zone -- with 30-day commercial paper at 6.5-6.6 against 6.65.
The central bank issued T$3 billion negotiable certificates of deposit on Monday to mop up an earlier issue of T$3 billion NCDs that was maturing today.
But dealers said funds remained loose in the banking system as some T$18 billion worth of NCDs were due to mature this week.
In the bond market, the benchmark 86/4 government bond yields were traded at 6.0765-0770 against 6.0755-0760.
